purpose: Finite measured runtime optimization after immutable continuation-meta delivery; no new mathematical quality hypothesis
profile: First measure existing exact-input cold and warm owned lower jobs, with phase CPU/wall, qualification incumbent/candidate, owner validation, gradient preparation and artifact IO. Profiling subsets are not runtime acceptance evidence.

speed_acceptance.scope: Complete existing finite experiment, all six outer contexts/48 outer trials and all eight final methods/three seeds/two rounds plus every existing final condition. Build, CI, pilot and offline audits remain separate.
speed_acceptance.fixed_workload_replay: All 96 exact owned training jobs, the original model/Adam tensors, plans, RNG/batch schedules and final diagnostic queries must also be checked. Report physical and allocated shared work separately; no cache-order advantage in the learned cost label.

quality_acceptance.fixed_inputs: Exact lower candidate and selected model/Adam bytes, first/last losses, plan predictions, RNG continuation, protected outcomes and native proof identities for unchanged numeric operations
quality_acceptance.actual_adaptive_run: All original >=5pp/no-negative-seed/strict-positive-family-CI criteria remain reported unchanged. Runtime changes do not turn a previously failed quality hypothesis into acceptance. Report every method/seed gain or regression against the baseline; a material loss prevents a same-quality claim.
quality_acceptance.data_status: All 192 prior/current final questions have been revealed. Repeated final evaluation is a labelled diagnostic regression comparison, never fresh held-out generalization.
quality_acceptance.operating: Real ordinary Node execution, pause/recovery, paired checkpoint provenance, resource accounting and independent native verification stay mandatory.

unchanged: all 250-update lower trials and upper updates
cache_contract: Use existing owner lifetimes. Bind every semantic input. Never cache unknown, deadline, OS/resource abort as a timeless negative. Every changed input rechecks; no serialized checked flag becomes mathematical authority.
stop: One finite profiling, implementation and controlled comparison scope. Preserve failed attempts. No automatic successor or indefinite tuning.
